The proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who undergo an echocardiography is a key quality indicator in Danish healthcare, with a national standard set at 80% or higher [^src1]. This comparison evaluates regional performance against this threshold to identify where diagnostic standards are being met and where patients may be missing out on crucial cardiac imaging.

[[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] is the clear leader, achieving a compliance rate of 84.5% and standing as the only region to successfully meet the ≥80% standard [^src1]. In stark contrast, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] trails significantly, recording the lowest rate in the country at just 59.9% [^src1]. 

The 80% target is missed by all other regions. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (75.3%), [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (72.4%), and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (70.0%) all fall short of the benchmark, as does the overall national average of 71.9% [^src1]. 

Because this comparison is based on a single dated section, broader multi-report trends cannot be independently established across different publications. However, the table's internal historical columns indicate that most regions have seen incremental year-over-year increases leading up to the current figures. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] is a notable outlier in this internal historical data, being the only region to show a slight dip from its immediately preceding year (dropping from 77.3% to 75.3%), though it still performs above the national average [^src1]. Meanwhile, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] remains a persistent outlier on the lower end, sitting nearly 12 percentage points below the national average [^src1].

The full 2023 and 2024 AFDK reports provide comprehensive background on the clinical guidelines and methodology underlying these indicators [^src2] [^src3] [^src4] [^src14]. They also detail broader cardiovascular quality metrics, data processing frameworks, and specific regional performance analyses that contextualize the national echocardiography standards [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src15].

**Entities:** region-midtjylland, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-nordjylland

**Summary:** Tabellen sammenligner opfyldelse af ekkokardiografi-standarden (≥80 %) på nationalt og regionalt niveau og viser, at kun Midtjylland opfylder standarden, mens alle øvrige regioner ligger under, og at der er en generel stigningstendens over tid i alle regioner.
